commitsEn: Draw motifs outside next as well — otherwise empty screen checks pass empty screens
Lottie: Change only point color to theme color
Add filtering tool to select Lottie candidates first
Don't fit single-image screens into phone frame
Create and run red team skill — fixed one XSS vulnerability in text page script

captions.ko: 사람 검토 없이 글이 올라가는 블로그라, 제목에 섞인 기호가 명령으로 읽히던 구멍을 막았습니다. 30분마다 돌던 자동 실행이 스스로 실패를 반복하던 것도 고쳤습니다.
captions.en: Posts here go live without review, so I closed the hole where a symbol in a title could run as a command. I also fixed the job that kept re-creating its own failure every 30 minutes.
